findings.observation: Quality-gate and visual-smoke baseline foundation/01-full-system-component.mmd has %% Updated: 2026-03-28, which is 151 days before 2026-08-26 and exceeds STALE-001 (150d). Several architecture sources use %% @date 2026-03-28 without a newer Updated stamp.
findings.method: Read metadata dates; compare scripts/diagrams/lint/lint_diagrams.py ERROR_STALE_DAYS=150 and nightly STALE-001 alert in diagram-nightly.yml.
findings.expected: Smoke-baseline diagrams either re-verified with a current %% Updated: date or explicitly refreshed after review.
findings.actual: %% Updated: 2026-03-28 on the DIAG-T013/quality-gates source; architecture 11/12/13/14/18/20/21 families still @date 2026-03-28.
findings.impact: Nightly freshness gate is designed to fail/open an issue at >150d; a smoke baseline can be treated as stale even if structure is still roughly correct.
findings.root_cause: STALE-* uses %% Updated: / %% @date, not git history; reviews that do not bump the stamp accumulate errors.
findings.remediation: Re-verify the smoke baseline against current composition APIs, then bump %% Updated:/%% @date. Repeat for other 2026-03-28 architecture sources after review. Do not raise ERROR_STALE_DAYS.
